name: DT Lords of Genomes
original_name: DTローズ・オブ・ゲノム
source:
You are a DT master. 
You can change the substance with the collected data and use it in fights. Governments, 
secret societies, religious organizations all aim to get that ability and attack it's owner. 
There are mysteries you need to understand - what's their purpose, why you became DT master, why each data was developed and what's the secret identity of DT. But first of all you need to survive.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
你是一名DT大师。
你能够利用收集到的数据改变物质，并将其用于战斗。政府、秘密结社和宗教组织都觊觎这种能力，纷纷向它的持有者发起袭击。
你需要解开许多谜团：他们究竟有何目的，你为何会成为DT大师，每份数据为何被开发出来，以及DT的真实身份究竟是什么。但在此之前，你首先必须活下去。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
